matching: STUMPY MASS on log adjusted closes, per-window z-normalization ddof=0
library: fixed training prefix only; candidate outcome must end within train and before query start
neighbors: greedy distance order, disjoint feature+outcome intervals, same symbol only
target: sign of log(close[t+20]/close[t]); forecast at closed bar t; no execution simulation
primary: paired holdout directional accuracy difference MASS minus each of trend and momentum
decision: Evidence within this sample only if both primary paired interval lower bounds > 0; otherwise no demonstrated advantage. No universal inference with 3 correlated survivors.
tuning: none; validation descriptive; parameters not selected from holdout
